title: What Is All-on-X: Complete Guide to Full-Arch Implants
seoTitle: What Is All-on-X? Full-Arch Implants Explained
seoDescription: All-on-X replaces a full arch of teeth on four or more implants. Learn the steps, typical costs, candidacy and upkeep. Plan a Valencia consultation.
excerpt: All-on-X replaces a full arch on four or more implants. Learn how it works step by step, what it typically costs, who qualifies and what upkeep to expect.
keyTakeaways: All-on-X is a fixed full-arch bridge on a small number of implants; the X is the implant count, commonly four or six.
Treatment runs from CBCT planning and any extractions to implant placement, often with a same-day provisional bridge.
The definitive prosthesis is delivered after three to six months of healing and is stronger than the provisional.
The article cites typical U.S. costs of $15,000 to $50,000 per arch depending on implant count, materials and grafting.
Uncontrolled diabetes, heavy smoking, untreated gum disease and head or neck radiation raise risk or rule patients out.
